note: Set A has fewer incorrect claims (6 vs 7). Both sets struggle with Millwork Schedule tag bindings (e.g., MWK04/MWK05/MWK02), but Set B additionally misbinds Furniture dimensions (assigning F2 dimensions to F8) and misidentifies MWK03 type. Set A correctly extracts Quartz (QZ) details which Set B omits, while Set B captures Wall Base (WB) and Glass (GL) details Set A misses. Set A's accuracy on Furniture dimensions (F7) is superior to Set B's (F8).
